name: Milestone Progress Rail
description: A vertical milestone rail with numbered checkpoints, an animated completion rule and focused stage notes for reviews, onboarding and handovers.

props.name: steps
props.description: Ordered stages with stable unique IDs, labels and plain-text details. ID keys retain focused stages through reordering.

props.name: current
props.description: Zero-based current index, clamped to the supplied stages. steps.length means all complete; invalid or negative values start at zero. The host owns this value.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Synchronous host navigation request with the clicked current-order index. Without it, stages are read-only. A request does not advance the host value automatically.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
